remarks_s_lower: doi:10.11646/phytotaxa.749.1.9 Zhang and Zhou, authors of the publication, attempt to validate the name by designation of a single type; a full and direct reference to original description is given. However, they then state that they do not accept it in Selaginella and provide a combination in Hypopterygiopsis. This is a somewhat complicated situation, as Art. 33.1 (ICN 2025) does not explicitly state who must accept the name, which might allow for it to be 'accepted' by the original authors G.Q.Gou and P.S.Wang. However, John Wiersema reacts to this: 'surely it must be the author(s) of the publication where it is being validly published'. Additionally, there is no evidence in the paper that Gou & Wang still accept the name 21 years later. This conclusion was shared with Nicholas Turland, John Wiersema, Julia Gravendyck, and Kanchi Gandi, who agree S. spinulosovena was not validly published here.
